Hi all — looping in a short note on timezone conversion to avoid the next-day issue.

If we pick Option A (2026-02-18 10:00 JST) the equivalent UTC time is 2026-02-18 01:00 UTC. For common US clients: that is 2026-02-17 17:00 PST (previous day). Office365/Outlook sometimes displays the event date relative to the organizer's clock; if the organizer's calendar is in PST the UI can show it as Feb 17 while Asian recipients see Feb 18 — the timezone offset makes it *look* like a different day.

Action steps I recommend we take now:
- Vanessa: recreate the calendar invite and set the event TZ explicitly to "Asia/Tokyo" for both start and end (ICS TZID settings).

- Attach an .ics that some folks can import directly.

I'll prepare a 1-slide agenda (demo focus + integration Q&A) and include it in the invite.
